fun_facts: Xavier Worthy is from Fresno, California.
Xavier Worthy played both football and track at Central East High School.
As a high school junior, Xavier Worthy helped Central East win its first state title after a 15–0 season, catching 55 passes for 992 yards and 16 touchdowns.
Xavier Worthy ran the 100 meters in 10.55 seconds as a sophomore.
As a Texas freshman, Xavier Worthy set school records with 62 catches, 981 receiving yards and 12 receiving touchdowns.
At the 2024 NFL Combine, Xavier Worthy ran the 40-yard dash in 4.21 seconds, setting a combine record.
